name: APTN Inc.
summary: APTN Inc. provides hydrothermal and geothermal heating and cooling systems in South Korea. It provides solar energy and fuel cell systems, as well as hydrothermal heating and cooling systems. The company also engages in the lithium extraction business. It serves domestic customers and public institutions. The company was formerly known as APT Neuroscience, Inc. and changed its name to APTN Inc. in August 2025. APTN Inc. was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Seongnam-si, South Korea.
